$comment: Root instance is one coverage cell. collection_count and record_denominator are collection accounting. They are never legal completeness. The value complete is rejected.
title: Worldwide legal-search coverage cell
description: Revision-pinned coverage for one jurisdiction, one administrative level, and one source capability. A known or partial cell names how many collections were pinned and the record denominator of those collections. legal_completeness stays not_claimed.

coverage_state.description: known, partial, missing, unknown, or unavailable. known describes the pinned collections only.

record_denominator.description: Non-negative count of viewer rows or metadata files in the pinned collections. Zero means the count was not published or this cell is not a counted level. It is not a census of the law.

collection_count.description: Non-negative number of included collections in this cell. This is not the record denominator and it is not legal completeness.

legal_completeness.description: Always not_claimed. A collection count, a record denominator, or a known coverage state does not make the law complete.

as_of.description: Calendar date or UTC timestamp of this coverage statement.

integrity.description: SHA-256 of the canonical cell identity, member revisions, counts, and coverage state.

jurisdiction_id.description: unstated when the disposition has no official jurisdiction id. A boundary dataset id is a source id, not an issuer id.

level.description: Administrative level used by the coverage matrix. other means the disposition did not state national, regional, or municipal.

capability.description: Source capability advertised by the pinned disposition, or boundary for the place registry.

denominator_kind.description: What record_denominator counts. viewer-rows and metadata-files are different units and are not added together.

uncounted_collections.description: Included collections in this cell whose viewer row count was absent. Their rows were not invented.

blocked_count.description: Collections at this cell that are blocked or unreadable. They are outside collection_count.

reason.description: Why the coverage state was chosen, including the distinction between collection counts, the record denominator, and legal completeness.
